Mira (Product Design): Heads up from the usability session: users often can't tell if Export applies to 'selected' vs 'visible'. Also compact rows remove the tiny vector preview that power users rely on. Fig: https://redwood.ai/s/vec-ux-2027 :mag:
Owen (Frontend): Heard. Quick fixes: 1) make the export button include scope in the label, e.g. `Export · selected: 2`; 2) anchor the dropdown so expanding rows don't push the toolbar; 3) render a 20px inline sparkline in compact mode (SVG) so scanning stays fast.
Priya (A11y): Accessibility notes: sparklines need a <title> or offscreen description like "preview: low to high". Chips must not rely on color alone — include an H/M/L character that's visually hidden but readable by screen readers. Export menu needs `aria-haspopup` and a focus trap; announce export start/complete with an aria-live region.
Dev (PM): From interviews: default behavior should be "Export selected" when rows are selected, otherwise default to "Export visible". Also add a small helper line under the button: "Exports selected rows unless you choose another option." Track analytics: export_scope, export_format, export_count. Warn on exports >5000 rows and offer background export.
Luca (Design Intern): Made two compact mocks: one with muted chips + small label, one with subtle borders and 20px sparklines. Uploaded: https://redwood.ai/s/mock-2027.png :art:
Owen (Frontend): CSS I can try in storybook:
``` .toolbar { position: sticky; top: 0; }
.export-btn { min-width: 160px; }
.row--compact .spark { width:20px; height:20px; display:inline-block; }
```
I'll persist compact preference in localStorage and add a feature flag `vec-export-scope-v1`. Branch: feat/vec-compact-export. ETA tomorrow AM.
Priya (A11y): Keyboard flow: Enter/Right Arrow to expand a row; focus must move to the first control inside the expanded panel. Left Arrow/Escape collapses and returns focus to the row. We'll run NVDA/VoiceOver on the prototype.
staging-bot: Storybook preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/builds/2027890123-storybook (includes compact toggle, sparklines, export scope badge).
Mira (Product Design): Great — checklist before PR: export scope label + helper copy, anchored dropdown, 20px sparkline with <title>, export aria labels and aria-live announcements, default export scope behavior, large-export warning, persist preference. Gate behind `vec-export-scope-v1` and pilot at 5%. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
